decisions.reason: Requiring an original creative does not alter the viral opening hook or its use of structural principles from the winning creative.
The fresh-perspective direction does not change the sales objective or target CPL.
A same-message MODIFY already completely records the proposed couple-discussion or multiple-patient testimonial presentation.
The originality and testimonial direction does not change the video count, duration, or aspect ratios.
The source changes creative originality and suggests testimonial scenarios but does not alter the existing realism or native-looking UGC standards.
The source does not change the specified audience age range.
The creative-direction change does not alter the freelancer's responsibility to supply footage, voiceover, and script.
The source concerns video creative direction and has no effect on the deferred landing-page and tracking audit.
The source does not change any audio-level, mix-element, or advertising-mix requirement.
The fresh-perspective and testimonial examples do not alter the required editing pace or cuts.
Although the suggested formats may contain dialogue, the source does not change the existing lip-sync standard.
The suggested couples or patients do not necessarily change the existing Indian-only casting rule or male preference.
